strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
...This area... I always figured there was something here.
When we met the Cyber Beast Force here before, I paid it little mind...
What the heck's going on... Hm?
Look at that, Shinobu! Something's different from last time!
Colony wreckage and asteroids... being drawn in?
Yeah, something's off. Is it... getting bigger?
Can this sort of thing even happen?
I'm not seeing things... It's definitely grown in size.
What's... happening?
It's getting bigger... Then maybe it'll become a planet people can live on!
Come on, Yurika... It's not a piece of fruit...
At its current rate of expansion it's fine, but if it got as big as you say,
the gravitational balance would collapse and cause a huge disaster.
But it's not a problem for now, right? It's not like there's an enemy...
...!! Enemy attack!?
Captain, have you pinpointed where they appeared!?
...Yes, I'm almost certain... It's from that asteroid.
We intercept, obviously. I'm heading out.
Tch, I knew it was fishy! So it was the enemy after all!
Let's get moving too! Everyone, don't fall behind!
All hands, Level 1 battle stations!
Ugh... The Ra Cailum too! Don't dawdle!
So this is Londo Bell... Heh heh, inferior beings need no tactics...
What matters is cleansing the Earth before the Dirad's revival...
How kind, they even brought new models that weren't here before...!
Seems they're giving us a welcome.
A rough welcome, though.
The Umon siblings, the Dangaioh team, and the Jin family too
all have alien ancestors. Maybe we'll get along with them.
Mia's from Earth, though~
We're Earthlings, y'know? Don't lump us in with aliens.
Quit yapping and let's get to it.
...Or maybe not get along?
But... to people from long ago, people born on Mars or in colonies
might seem like aliens, too...
This is it, the spot Big Sis Diondra was talkin' about.
Eek, what's that?
Aaah! That pesky invading army!
The space crime syndicate... the Gyandlar! What are they doing here!?
Hmm? What, more of those pain-in-the-neck Earthlings around!?
Quit gettin' in our way already!
These guys... For a space crime syndicate, they sure seem like grunts.
Whaddaya say!? Don't talk nonsense!
We're the Gyandlar's Phantom Soldier Commanders, who scare kids silent,
Devil Saturn 6!!
Cutting loose with threats like that is what makes you a grunt!
...Cutting... a tanker?
Darn right, I've sliced a space tanker or two clean through like this...
Awful. ...Also, I don't know what a space tanker is.
Whaddaya makin' me do, ya dope! No time to play along with corny gags.
Dang it, Earthlings, just quit gettin' in our way!!
Where's Gil!? Aren't you teamed up with the Bunker!?
Gil? Bunker? Don't talk nonsense!
I'm only doin' this 'cause I got orders!
Meaning what? Then are the Bunker and the Gyandlar even linked...?
Don't take what the enemy says at face value.
Infighting within an organization is common enough.
What a troublesome bunch! What now? Do we fight?
Even if we don't want to fight, they look all fired up.
This is the worst...
They seem set on fighting. What a pain.
Looks like we have no choice.
Weird energy reading, they said... and I get stuck with the short straw!
That guy's doing nothing but whining.
...But does that mean this mysterious army really has nothing
to do with the Bunker or the Gyandlar!?
Seems we'll have to look into this ourselves.
Tch, let's scatter 'em fast! I've got a bad feeling about this!
Yeah. This area... and that asteroid... Something's unsettling.
Now... time to finish this...!
Here they come, in droves!
What a weird bunch.
...Eh, if they ain't gonna attack, fightin' 'em ain't worth the bother.
What did you even come here for, huh!?
Well, we gotta fight these Earthlings anyway. ...So this is the end for ya!
Don't talk so big! Try it if you think you can!
We won't lose!
...Sara...
Hm? What's wrong, Sara?
Ah, yeah... It's nothing. Let's wrap this up quick, Shinobu!
Weird.
Interesting... What interesting creatures.
But I can't see why he cares so much about them.
...Heh heh, but if I slaughter them all here, I needn't know.
Get ready, Earthlings!
Kenrou! Show me your power!
Devil Saturn, that's far enough.
The space pirates don't seem to be with them this time.
Maybe they had a fight?
That's not funny. It sounds likely.
Scurryin' around... Dang it, I'll take ya all out together!
...Strange... Why are the Gyandlar holding back their forces like this?
Grr, that's it for now!
I'm done messin' with some weird asteroid that don't earn me a dime!
And if that lunkhead Rom shows up, it'll be a total mess!
Whoa there! You're not getting away this time!
Brother! What do we do!?
Their goal is clear.
The proof is that only Devil Saturn showed up here.
After them! We have to stop them...!
Wait!
What are you...
And how are the Gyandlar and the Bunker connected?
And we'd like to know who you are, too.
Oh, same here.
What do we do, Rom?
...The Gyandlar's ultimate target... is Earth.
What do you mean?
Explain it to us.
Brother, maybe we should...
Yes, I know, Leina.
...The time will likely come when we must borrow your strength...
Ah! Hey, wait!
They're gone...
A true wandering hero. They'll need our help? What's that mean?
Their target is Earth... but why, I have no idea.
Here one second, gone the next... Can't they ever stay put?
They're helping us, so quit complaining.
...But what does it mean? The Gyandlar are after Earth...
and they'll need our help...?
You hear that? A hero of justice like that needs our help!
Man, I'm glad I became a pilot!
But we never did find out who they are... They do seem to be on our side...
"Some call them champions of justice"... Well, that's just stating it.
Anyway, at least we found out
what the Gyandlar are after. That's something, Captain Bright.
Yes, it may give us something to go on.
Right, they made things much easier. Mop up the remaining enemies!
Finally done. What a troublesome asteroid.
Is it really okay to just leave this thing? Captain, what's the call?
Then again, it's not as though we have a way to destroy it...
Isn't it an enemy base?
I considered that... but the only readings are plant readings.
No life signs or metal readings at all!?
In that case... those robot-like things that attacked may be living things.
So that asteroid's a hive... and the robots are soldiers guarding it?
That may be a good way to put it, Lieutenant Uraki.
Then we'd best keep away. Captain, what do you think?
I say we declare this area off-limits and leave it be.
I'm in favor of that as well.
Needlessly provoking something that's lying dormant
is poor value for the cost, too.
Ruri, how's the asteroid's expansion?
No expansion has been confirmed since we made contact.
Then can't we just come back if something else strange happens?
Like Prospector said, it doesn't seem like we've got
time to go poking sleeping bears...
Feels kinda like running away, I don't like it.
Can't we blast it with the Moon Attack?
It's way too big for that.
I'm all for leaving it alone.
Well, no need to go sticking our noses in.
Besides, what that Rom guy said bugs me.
If the Gyandlar are after Earth...
Then Gil and the Bunker... are they after it too?
If Gil's descent to Earth before was aimed at more
than just luring Mia out... it's possible.
Looks like it's settled. Let's hurry on ahead.
This place gives me the creeps.
If that's decided, best we get out of here fast.
Mm... Right, we'll keep this place from Commander Hazuki.
The Gandor team's apparently got its hands full.
We shouldn't give him anything more to worry about.
All right, back to the ship... Huh? Ryo?
Something's off. I can't help sensing some kind of evil will...
but it can't be helped.
